propositions: Each attempted fallback candidate must emit exactly one rebar OpenTelemetry span with zero-based order and provider-qualified model identity, parenting to the single Agent model-request span via ambient OTel context, with no duplication from instrument_all.

Candidate spans must carry an outcome from the closed vocabulary {returned, raised} and provider-reported usage only when exposed by the SDK; failure reasons must be sanitized through sanitize_diagnostic under the message key with no prompt, response, credential, or endpoint data.

The existing ordered FallbackExceptionGroup resolution and the S2-preserved bug-895c native-to-prompted fallback (native attempt raised then prompted attempt returned) must remain unchanged by instrumentation with no modifications to _pai_structured control flow.
Span-emission or exporter failures while tracing is enabled must be swallowed at the wrapper boundary, leaving fallback result, RunUsage, and propagated exceptions identical to tracing-off.
Usage counters, UsageLimits, pricing, and durable JSONL must remain identical with tracing on and off and contain no candidate counter.
Base install without tracing extra imports must run with no span dependency error.
